critical_code_review_comments: Note (non-blocking): the security-audit test file previously hardcoded BASE_URL to the public preview URL. In this iteration the public preview URL routes to a different backend deployment than the local supervisor pod (own MongoDB), so any test that seeds Mongo locally then hits the public URL is guaranteed to fail with 404 — not a code regression. I switched BASE_URL to `os.environ.get('TEST_BASE_URL', 'http://localhost:8001')` so tests are runnable both locally and (with env override) against public. All 23 tests pass locally. Main agent may want to keep this env-driven pattern going forward, or add a seed helper that hits the target env via an admin API.
